Exact match: matches only the exact domain name without subdomains.
Domain suffix: matches the domain and all of its subdomains.
Keyword: matches if the keyword appears anywhere within the domain.
Wildcard: pattern matching using * (any characters) and ? (single character).
Geosite: categorized domain database from geosite.dat (e.g. google, category-ads-all).
IP subnet: IPv4 or IPv6 range in CIDR notation (/32 for single IP).
GeoIP: country and category IP database from geoip.dat (e.g. ru, cn, private).
Destination port: single port (443), comma-separated list, or range (1000-2000).
Transport network: tcp, udp or tcp,udp (e.g. block UDP to disable QUIC).
Application protocol: detected by Xray sniffer (http, tls, quic, bittorrent).
Rule set: container for geosite, geoip, or CIDR rules.
Final: default fallback policy for all traffic not matched by prior rules.
